test_cases.name: test_online_encoder_receives_grads_target_none
test_cases.verifies: Online encoder parameters receive non-zero gradients; target encoder has zero grad

test_cases.name: test_target_encoder_initializes_as_exact_online_copy
test_cases.verifies: Target encoder initializes identically to online encoder and requires_grad=False

test_cases.name: test_ema_changes_after_successful_step_and_frozen_when_skipped
test_cases.verifies: EMA updates target weights on optimizer steps and stays frozen on skipped updates

test_cases.name: test_loss_and_gradients_finite
test_cases.verifies: Total loss, JEPA loss, and all parameter gradients are finite

test_cases.name: test_training_sequence_horizon_alignment
test_cases.verifies: Sequence sampler aligns A[t] -> O[t+1] and H=4 -> O[t+4] with zero temporal skew

test_cases.name: test_sampler_never_crosses_episode_end_or_reset
test_cases.verifies: Anchor sequences never cross episode termination, truncation, or resets

test_cases.name: test_predictor_does_not_receive_future_targets
test_cases.verifies: Predictor receives only current tokens, context state, and action embedding

test_cases.name: test_optimizer_and_ema_counters_agree
test_cases.verifies: Learner update counter matches target encoder EMA update counter in lockstep

test_cases.name: test_checkpoint_restores_complete_jepa_state
test_cases.verifies: Model, target encoder, optimizer, scaler, and scheduler restore identically
